_frozen: 2026-10-11, before any backend code, benchmark or run of Experiment B (docs/final_campaign/PREREGISTRATION.md section 2, revised after the pre-freeze adversarial review).

hardware_allocation.layout: two L3 groups (CCDs, 8 cores each) of one NUMA node; SMT siblings (c+128) idle
hardware_allocation.environment: every timed run: t<=8 -> one CCD to itself; t=16 -> two CCDs of one node; no other campaign process on those CCDs or siblings; CCDs chosen with all cores+siblings <=10 % busy over 2 s; wait (poll 30 s) up to 30 min, else least-loaded set and flag
hardware_allocation.telemetry: monitor pinned outside allocations: /proc/stat 1 Hz for every core+sibling of each active run's CCDs, scaling_cur_freq; per-run involuntary context switches of its threads

backend.gateway: C/OpenMP per-step kernel (gcc -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off) + validated numba FR step

noise_modes.replay: validated serial stream (gateway numba MT19937 default_noise_seed; LTA PCG64 SeedSequence([seed,N,T]) child 1)
noise_modes.counter: Philox4x64-10, key from SeedSequence([seed, N, 2]) (gateway) / SeedSequence([seed, N, 150, 2]) (LTA 150 K), counter (step, slot, word), Box-Muller

backend.reduction_order: deposits added per bin in slot order (thread-count invariant)

validation.V-B1: replay bitwise = validated engine (diag off), threads {1,4,16}, both arms; gateway N {16,64,512} (>=12 t.u. at N16, >=6 t.u. at N64/512); LTA150 N {2 ABF only, 16, 64, 512} (>=200000 steps at N16/64, >=60000 at N512, >=40000 at N2); each >=20 saves and FR arms >=50 realised deaths; LTA-only fallback for reassociated LJ sum: identical integer outputs + max|dq|<=1e-8 A (amendment)
validation.V-B2: counter mode bitwise invariant over threads {1,2,4,8,16}
validation.V-B3: (i) Philox4x64-10 == numpy Philox oracle (>=1e4 counters x 4 keys); (ii) counter map injective over every production (N, n_steps, words); (iii) 1e8 normals: mean, variance, skewness, excess kurtosis, lag-1 corr across steps/slots/words, Box-Muller partner corr, KS -> two-sided p, Holm over 9, FWER 1 %
validation.V-B4: per system and arm in {core small-N ABF, ABF512, FR512}: counter mode 32 fresh seeds vs validated engine (gateway 8100-8131 production; LTA 15000-15015 production + 15340-15355 new validated); pass iff 95 % bootstrap CI of ratio of median Ibar_F in [0.85, 1.18] for every arm AND 95 % CI of difference of median paired G at N512 within +-0.10; one extension (+32 seeds per side) if a CI exceeds the band with point estimate in [0.93, 1.075] (resp. +-0.05); R1-R5 reported descriptively
validation.V-B5: counter-mode ABF/FR arms bitwise identical before FR's first realised death
validation.stop: a failure stops Experiment B for that system

candidates.implementations: parallel engine counter mode t in {1,2,4,8,16} (t<=N) + validated serial engine (diag off, 1 core)

feasibility.F1: for both N=512 arms: best parallel throughput over t<=16 >= 6.0 x validated serial engine throughput at N=512 on 1 core
feasibility.F1b: for FR512: best parallel throughput over t<=16 >= 4.0 x the parallel engine's own t=1 throughput
feasibility.rule: both F1 and F1b per system; a failing system's production is not run

primary_endpoint: W_mid: wall seconds from timed start to the first save of the persistent window at the mid e_F threshold; censored = inf; sensitivity: log-linear interpolation between last failing and first persistent save
decisive_comparison: FR advantage iff exists FR arm f with, for every ABF arm a, upper end of (1-0.05/|F|) percentile CI of rho(f,a)=medW_f/medW_a < 1; ABF advantage iff exists ABF arm a with, for every FR arm f, lower end of (1-0.05/|A|) CI > 1; else unresolved. Bootstrap 10000, default_rng(20261010), per-arm independent resampling except ABF512/FR512 share index draws; finite/inf=0, inf/finite=inf, inf/inf undefined (>2.5 % undefined -> unresolved). Descriptive rho_best with re-selection on both sides.
contention: contended for an endpoint if over its wall window any core/sibling of the run's CCDs has foreign busy > 0.10 or > 5 involuntary ctx switches per thread-second; repeat until an uncontended replicate (<= 3 repeats), keep all records; primary = first uncontended replicate; runs with none flagged, excluded from primary, included in sensitivity
cost_accounting: ceiling counted in used core-h = t_arm x wall; allocated core-h = 16 x wall reported
competitor_completion: W_proj(N, method) = Q50_s[tau_mid_u(N, method, s)] (equal-budget production per-seed, censoring-aware) x B x c*(N, method) (best measured wall per walker-step over implementations); add the ABF candidate and the FR candidate with smallest W_proj if not core arms (<= 1 extra arm per method and system); recorded before production
implementation_rule: per arm: fastest median throughput among {validated serial engine, parallel engine t in {1,2,4,8,16}, t<=N}; within 3 % of best = tie; ties to fewer cores (serial engine = 1 core, wins tie with parallel t=1); serial-engine arms run validated replay noise; recorded before production
save_grid: Experiment B only, identical in u for all arms: u = k/200 (k=1..200) union log-spaced u ratio 1.02 from 1e-4 to 1; steps = unique(clip(round(u n_steps), 1, n_steps))
run_order: seed-major blocks; arm order within a seed permuted by default_rng(20261011 + seed); drift reference (gateway FR512, t=16, 2 % of B) every 30 min
resolution: ratio-of-medians 95 % CI about x/1.3 (gateway, 64 seeds) and x/1.22 (LTA, 32 seeds): resolvable only outside ~[0.77, 1.3] and ~[0.82, 1.22]
